ai-chat-kit · Storybook walkthrough

The chat experience, end to end

A tour of the chat UI kit: the full chat app, how answers cite their sources, the embeddable widget on a host site, and how it adapts to dark mode and phones.

Captured at 1440 × 900, 2× resolutionAll conversations are canned demo dataClick any screenshot to enlarge

Full chat app

The complete page assembled from the kit's components: sidebar with filters and recent chats, the conversation, and a reference pane that opens beside it.

Embeddable widget

The same chat as a launcher on someone else's website. It mounts with one script tag inside a shadow root, so the host page's styles can't leak in.

Settings and small screens

People can pick a palette and a highlight color, and the full app reflows to phone width.

Every screen comes from the kit's Storybook stories. Nothing here connects to a real backend: answers replay canned turns or a simulated network.
